credential_type.quote: "Perfusionist" means a person who is licensed to practice perfusion by the Board.

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: Hold himself or herself out as a perfusionist or use any other term indicating or implying that he or she is a perfusionist without being licensed by the Board

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, mental/physical condition, or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, a mental or physical condition or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or any other substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct intended to deceive or that violates standards of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct: (1) Which is intended to deceive; (2) Which the Board has determined is a violation of the standards of practice established by regulation of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing controlled substances except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond scope or performing services the licensee is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or which are beyond the scope of his or her training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report, or failing to file required records or reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report within 30 days any disciplinary action taken in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report within 30 days any criminal action or conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct per Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of or ability to practice medicine/perfusion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action including revocation, suspension, modification or surrender of license in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license to practice any type of medicine, taken by another state, the Federal Government, a foreign country or any other jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice, as evidenced by claims settled against the practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner, but only if the malpractice is established by a preponderance of the evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing or attempting to obtain, maintain or renew a license to practice medicine by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by any false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising any unlicensed person to engage in the practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine contrary to the provisions of this chapter or the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate, and complete medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records relating to the diagnosis, treatment and care of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report malpractice actions, claims, settlements, awards, or sanctions to the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist shall report to the Board: (a) Any action for malpractice

definition_quote.value: the performance of functions which are necessary to provide for the support, treatment, measurement or supplementation of a patient's cardiovascular, circulatory or respiratory system or other organs, or any combination of those activities, and to ensure the safe management of the patient's physiological functions by monitoring and analyzing the parameters of the patient's systems or organs under the order and supervision of a physician.
definition_quote.quote: "Perfusion" means the performance of functions which are necessary to provide for the support, treatment, measurement or supplementation of a patient's cardiovascular, circulatory or respiratory system or other organs, or any combination of those activities, and to ensure the safe management of the patient's physiological functions by monitoring and analyzing the parameters of the patient's systems or organs under the order and supervision of a physician.

value: extracorporeal circulation and associated therapeutic and diagnostic technologies
methods_authorized.quote: The term includes, without limitation: (a) The use of extracorporeal circulation and any associated therapeutic and diagnostic technologies; and (b) The use of long-term cardiopulmonary support techniques.

provisional_license_available.quote: The Board may issue a temporary license to practice perfusion in this State to a person who has not yet completed the examination required pursuant to NRS 630.2692

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A temporary license is valid for 1 year after the date it is issued and may be extended subject to regulation by the Board.

provisional_license_supervisor_physical_.quote: A perfusionist shall supervise and direct a temporarily licensed perfusionist at all times during which the temporarily licensed perfusionist performs perfusion.

graduate_perfusionist_title.quote: "Temporarily licensed perfusionist" means a person temporarily licensed to practice perfusion by the Board pursuant to NRS 630.2696.
